moves.sectionTitle: Teleology and the inference to God
moves.currentDescription: Meaning, purpose, and value begin in living self-maintenance and can unfold through evolution into complex human systems.
moves.lockedProposition: Meaning, purpose, and value begin in living self-maintenance and can unfold through evolution into complex human systems.

moves.sectionTitle: Teleology and the inference to God
moves.currentDescription: Real shaping, directionality, and values together imply something recognizably like an involved God.
moves.lockedProposition: Real shaping, directionality, and values together imply something recognizably like an involved God.
